describe: The image shows a wide mountain sky panorama: snow-capped grey and dark-blue peaks rise from a misty white cloud bank along the bottom. Three main summits sit centre and left, with lighter snowy ridges on the right. The sky is a muted teal-blue at the top, shifting to pale grey-green near the horizon. Soft haze and low cloud veil the lower half, and the light is soft and diffuse with low contrast. No transparent areas.
